If you are the owner of this website and are seeing this page, then your hosting account is fully set up. To upload your website, log in to your cPanel and under File Manager, locate the public_html folder and upload your website there. You can also do so through use of an FTP application.

Make sure you locate and delete this page, index.html under the public_html folder only before you begin uploading your website or after using a one click installer to install a CMS application.
